dialogues.speaker: Chronie
dialogues.text: What's up with these meka monsters? Why do they move sometimes and stop moving at others!?

dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: I fear that anyone who could've answered your question is now... well, indisposed.

dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: #Let's hurry over to the Institute. {NICKNAME} needs to participate in the final qualification review, after all.
